extension_name: Grammarly: AI Writing Assistant and Grammar Checker App

observed_categories.reason: Full text body, corrections, and edit sessions of documents checked by the user are transmitted to Grammarly APIs for real-time spelling, grammar, and AI assistance.
User access tokens, cookie data, and credentials used to authorize API calls to premium/personal features.
Anonymized or pseudonymous behavioral events, clicks, hover times, writing sessions, and error logs are collected to monitor product usage.
Configurable user preferences such as writing language, dictionary words, and active/inactive sites.

overall_assessment.summary: Consistent: Grammarly's external privacy policy is highly comprehensive and accurately covers all observed data categories, including 'website_content', 'user_activity', and 'authentication_information'. Overdeclared categories arise from the policy's multi-product scope.

limitations: The general privacy policy applies to multiple products (Grammarly, Superhuman, Coda) and therefore declares categories wider than what is observed in this single extension.
